**These files cannot be installed as they are.** A Samsung TV only accepts packages signed with a Samsung certificate that lists that TV, so sign both with your own certificate profile first. The steps are in the [guide](https://github.com/stanislavnastasiu-dev/HyperTizen/blob/main/docs/README.md#installation).

- `io.gh.reisxd.HyperTizen-<version>.tpk`: the service that captures the screen colors.
- `HyperTizenUI-<version>.wgt`: the setup and settings UI, as a TV app. It is not needed if you add the UI as a TizenBrew module.
